== Biography ==

The title "Queen" is applied in the Emerald City and its surrounding lands to several distinct ruling figures. It names the small grey Queen of the Field Mice, who guides the Scarecrow and his companions toward the Emerald City and leads them unharmed through a deceptive fire. It also names Jinjur, who proclaims herself Queen of the Emerald City after seizing the throne, threatens to turn the Woggle-Bug into soup, and later refuses to surrender the crown even as Glinda's army marches on the city. The title further applies to Glinda the Good, called the Queen of the Southland, who rules from her palace in the South Country and is sought out for advice, and to Ozma, who is described by her subjects as ruling the Emerald City and accomplishing things unexpected of her.
